portfolio_decisions.reason: The 24-page Bigster source is fully assimilated in the 2026-11-25 report with explicit deferrals.
The 22-page Spring source-to-master reconciliation is complete on current main; no duplicate technical observations are justified.
Current-main closure receipts and exact master reconciliation confirm the reviewed observations and preserved conflicts; only a broader inventory remains a future candidate.
All 16 selected records are already present under the exact source; no missing selected import-ready records.

It is a 21-page active brochure with only targeted page 17-19 reviews and no complete source-wide inventory; a full inventory is required to expose any genuinely new source-backed gaps before data mutation.
Duster pages 20-23 have substantial exact review/import receipts; its source-wide inventory remains incomplete but the Stepway source has the more immediate unreviewed full-document gap.

master changes are limited to independently verified exact gaps; otherwise the package closes review-only with zero mutation
